name: mycase-piece
label: MyCase
description: Automate legal case management workflows with MyCase. Create and manage cases, clients, companies, events, tasks, time entries, documents, and more. Get notified when cases, events, people, companies, or leads are added or updated.

find_or_create_case.label: Find or Create Case
find_or_create_case.description: Finds a case by name or creates a new one if it does not exist

name.label: Case Name
name.description: The name of the case to find or create

case_number.label: Case Number
case_number.description: An identifier for this case (used only when creating)

opened_date.label: Opened Date
opened_date.description: The date the case was created/opened (used only when creating)

case_stage.label: Case Stage
case_stage.description: The stage the case is currently in (used only when creating)

practice_area.label: Practice Area
practice_area.description: The practice area for this case (used only when creating)

description.label: Description
description.description: A description for the case (used only when creating)

sol_date.label: Statute of Limitations Date
sol_date.description: The statute of limitations date (used only when creating)

status.label: Status
status.description: The status of the case (used only when creating)

outstanding_balance.label: Outstanding Balance
outstanding_balance.description: The outstanding balance of this case (used only when creating)

billing_contact.label: Billing Contact
billing_contact.description: The client or company to assign as the billing contact (used only when creating)

clients.label: Clients
clients.description: Clients to associate with the case (used only when creating)

companies.label: Companies
companies.description: Companies to associate with the case (used only when creating)

staff.label: Staff
staff.description: Staff members to associate with the case (used only when creating)

lead_lawyer.label: Lead Lawyer
lead_lawyer.description: Select the lead lawyer for this case (used only when creating)

originating_lawyer.label: Originating Lawyer
originating_lawyer.description: Select the originating lawyer for this case (used only when creating)
